subject: Technical onboarding: hands-on workshop + firewall allowlist
messages:
From: Andrew Choi <andrew.choi@acmehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ashley Park <ashley.network@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: hands-on workshop and staging access for POC

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move to a short hands-on workshop to validate routing and cost numbers. We'd like to schedule a 90-minute session that covers: a quick prompt review, routing / model-selection tests, and a light load run to surface latency profiles.

Before we lock a date, our security/network team needs the exact allowlist IPs and any staging hostnames so we can open the firewall and provision a sandbox service account. Can you also confirm what kind of API keys you’ll provide (short-lived tokens vs. long-lived service keys) and how you prefer us to upload any test data?

Availability from our side: Jan 13–15 (10am–3pm ET).

Thanks — looping in Ashley (network) who will manage the allowlist.

—Andrew
Andrew Choi
Principal, Integration Platform
Acme Health
andrew.choi@acmehealth.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: none
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 12:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: hands-on workshop and staging access for POC

Hi Andrew — great to hear. We can run a 90-minute hands-on session that covers prompt review, routing policy tests, and a short load run (we typically do burst windows up to ~200 RPS for 5–10 minutes to capture latency tails).

Proposed slots (PT): Jan 13 09:00–10:30, Jan 13 13:00–14:30, Jan 14 11:00–12:30. You mentioned 10am–3pm ET which maps fine to those windows — let me know which you prefer and I'll book the calendar and send invites.

Pre-session checklist — please provide the following before EOD Jan 12 if possible so Diego can validate staging connectivity: 
- Sandbox service account or credential upload (short-lived service key preferred)
- Firewall allowlist: we will provide a small set of egress IPs and a couple of hostname endpoints (see note below)
- Staging endpoint hostnames and any required headers (Auth type, tenant id)
- A handful of representative prompts (we can use the examples you already shared)

We will provide:
- A short runbook (attached) with test plan and rollback steps
- Load test config and sample prompt file ahead of the session
- A dedicated meeting host (Diego) + CS presence (Vivek)

Attachment: poc-runbook.pdf (PDF, 98KB)

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick reply. Jan 13 13:00–14:30 PT (which is 4:00–5:30 ET) works best for our devs — can we do that slot?

Couple of follow-ups from Ashley:
- Can you list the exact IP ranges we should allow (CIDR) rather than hostnames alone? Our firewall policy requires CIDRs.
- For the sandbox service account: can Redwood create a short-lived service key that expires after 7 days, or do we need to provision a long-lived key on our side?
- For uploading test data: we prefer a secure S3-presigned URL. Is that OK?

Ash — can you confirm you'll open the listed CIDRs if Naomi provides them?

Thanks,
—Andrew

Thanks — Jan 13 13:00–14:30 PT is confirmed on our side. Calendar invite on the way.

Per Ashley's CIDR request, here are the ranges we use for hosted sessions (egress from Redwood):
- 54.172.32.0/22
- 54.244.0.0/15
- 34.200.0.0/16
- 52.67.128.0/17

Staging hostnames (TLS):
- staging-api.redwood-inference.com
- staging-uploads.redwood-inference.com

We will provide a short-lived service key that expires after 7 days. Please upload your test data via a pre-signed S3 link — we'll generate a single-use signed URL and share via the secure drive folder (link below).

Attachments: loadtest-config.yaml (YAML, 3KB), sample-prompts.md (MD, 4KB)

Pre-session checklist (diego will run these at start):
1) Validate DNS resolution to staging hostnames from your staging network
2) Verify firewall allows outbound to the CIDRs above on ports 443 and 80
3) Confirm receipt of short-lived service key and test a single auth call
4) Smoke test 10 sample prompts end-to-end

Secure files & links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-acme-poc (access: external collaborator)

If Ashley can confirm the CIDRs will be allowed by EOD Jan 12 your network team will be in good shape for the session. Diego will be available 30 minutes before the start to troubleshoot access.

—Naomi

Thanks Naomi — we will allowlist the CIDRs you provided. A couple of notes from our side: 
- Firewall window: we'll open the rules 24 hours before the session start and close them 48 hours after (can adjust if you need longer).
- We prefer CIDR-only rules; please avoid relying on hostname-based exceptions for the production firewall.
- Please confirm the kickoff time in ET so we log the expected window (your invite in PT was helpful).

Confirmed: Jan 13 13:00–14:30 PT (4:00–5:30 ET). We'll have a network engineer on the call at start to help validate.

—Ashley
